tools.baristaTipBody: Lower ratios (1:12 - 1:14) result in drinks with heavier body and pronounced caramel sweetness. Higher ratios (1:16 - 1:18) favor delicate, malic acidity and floral notes.

smoothFloral.desc: Highlights acidity and aroma in pour-over

v60-46.name: V60 — 4:6 Method (Tetsu Kasuya)
v60-46.description: World Brewers Cup champion method. Splits 40% of water for acidity/sweetness and 60% for body.

e1.name: Bloom (Pre-infusão)
e1.instruction: Pour 60ml of water in circular motions to release CO2 gases (degassing).

e2.name: Pour 1 (Sweetness & Acidity)
e2.instruction: Pour until reaching 120ml total. Firm pour in the center.

e3.name: Pour 2 (Body)
e3.instruction: Pour until 180ml total. Maintain a steady flow.

e5.name: Final Pour & Drawdown
e5.instruction: Pour until 300ml final. Wait for the water to drain completely through the filter.

aeropress-invertido.name: Aeropress — Standard Inverted Method
aeropress-invertido.description: Rapid immersion extraction followed by manual pressure filtering.

a1.name: Fast Bloom
a1.instruction: Pour 60ml of boiling water (92°C) and stir gently with the paddle for 10 seconds.

a2.name: Full Fill
a2.instruction: Pour the remaining water up to 224ml. Attach the filter cap with rinsed paper filter without pressing.

a3.name: Press Plunger
a3.instruction: Flip the Aeropress onto the cup and press the plunger gently for 30s until you hear a hiss of air.

prensa-francesa.name: French Press — Hoffmann Method
prensa-francesa.description: Clean and full-bodied method without sediment bitterness, popularized by James Hoffmann.

p1.name: Total Direct Infusion
p1.instruction: Pour all 320ml of boiling water quickly ensuring all grounds are wet. Wait 4 minutes.

p2.name: Break Crust & Stir
p2.instruction: Stir the top crust gently with a spoon so grounds sink to the bottom.

p3.name: Final Decanting
p3.instruction: Wait for oils and particles to settle. Place plunger on top without pressing down.

chemex-suave.name: Chemex — Elegant Glass Filter
chemex-suave.description: Clean extraction with thicker paper filter, highlighting floral and fruity notes.

c1.name: Extended Bloom
c1.instruction: Pour 75ml of water and wait for the coffee bed to expand.

c2.name: Main Pour 1
c2.instruction: Pour slowly in a circular motion until reaching 200ml total.

c3.name: Main Pour 2 & Drawdown
c3.instruction: Complete up to 400ml water. Allow liquid to drain by gravity.
